Title: vmtest: report the real reason when a libvirt lease wait times out
Body: WaitLibvirtLease in internal/vmtest/libvirt_lease.go reports the last virsh net-dhcp-leases call as signal: killed when a deadline expires. Report no DHCP lease for the MAC and the elapsed timeout instead.

Title: vmtest: report the last lease lookup when the lease wait times out
Body: WaitLibvirtLease (internal/vmtest/libvirt_lease.go) reports signal: killed from the virsh net-dhcp-leases call instead of the last informative result. Report no DHCP lease for the MAC and the elapsed wait.

Title: vmtest: capture virtio carrier loss before a DHCP lease arrives
Body: The guest lost carrier before TestInstalledRuntimeConfigApplyModesSmoke could obtain a libvirt DHCP lease. Capture the tap, bridge and link transitions while running the recovery test.

Title: katlctl: check the running version before uploading an upgrade image
Body: katlctl node upgrade --artifact uploads the whole runtime image even when the node already runs that version. Compare artifact version and digest against running and staged generations before uploading.

Title: katlctl: refuse node upgrade before uploading the image
Body: katlctl node upgrade uploads the whole runtime image before a preflight refusal. Run preflight before uploading the image and report the refusal and next step.

Title: Recovery workflows for management authentication

Title: katlctl: recover management trust after lost secrets
Body: Recover lost management secrets with katlctl management identity recover over root SSH. Read the CA fingerprint and rotate authority with katlc agent rotate-management.

Title: ci: gate merge-queue entry on one admission verdict
Body:
A Hold line or auto-merge state must never leave a PR unexplained. Every reason names the owner and what clears it. Every ready PR is queued, awaiting review, or has a hold. Absorbs the hold workflow from #795.

Title: katl-queue: own PR holds and their labels end to end
Body: Turning auto-merge off leaves a PR unexplained. Every ready PR is queued, awaiting review, or has a Hold line naming what clears it.

Title: katl-queue: resolve the GitHub repository once
Body: Two owners resolve repository identity independently. A fixed repository and a remote lookup disagree outside this checkout. Bind one repository once and reuse the selection for every request.

Title: release: keep one owner for GitHub repository identity
Body: Publisher requests resolve repository identity independently. A configured repository and a remote lookup disagree outside the checkout. Bind one repository once and reuse the selection for each request.

Title: release: show repository status
Body: Display the GitHub repository name and release milestone in the progress table when reading artifact status.
